mapper.select: SELECT project_id, project_code, title, start_date, deleted FROM project WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY project_id

SELECT p.project_id, p.project_code, p.title, p.start_date, p.deleted, e.empno AS e_empno, e.ename AS e_ename, e.job AS e_job, e.mgr AS e_mgr, e.hiredate AS e_hiredate, e.sal AS e_sal, e.comm AS e_comm, e.deptno AS e_deptno, e.deleted AS e_deleted FROM project p LEFT JOIN employee_project link ON link.project_id = p.project_id LEFT JOIN emp e ON e.empno = link.empno AND e.deleted = 0 WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId} AND p.deleted = 0 ORDER BY e.empno
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project (project_code, title, start_date, deleted) VALUES (#{projectCode}, #{title}, #{startDate,jdbcType=DATE}, 0)
